title: Andy Serkis Defends His ‘Hunt for Gollum’ Cast and Confirms He’s Not Directing Stephen Colbert’s ‘Lord of the Rings’ Film
summary: The British actor-filmmaker addressed criticism around the lack of diversity in his 'Lord of the Rings' film, which currently stars Anya Taylor-Joy, Leo Woodall, Kate Winslet and Jamie Dornan.
tags: Lord of the Rings: Hunt for Gollum
